solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Animated extremely inhuman creepy-crawly with rounded back half

indicators.note: extremely picks the very ends of the word inhuman, its first and last letters
rounded means turned round, and back half limits that turn to the rear three letters of the creepy-crawly

parts.note: a spider is a typical creepy-crawly

explanation.surface: Something lively but very inhuman, a creepy-crawly with a curved hindquarters, like a monster in a film.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rounded back half' turns only the rear three letters of the creepy-crawly, making RED of them.
explanation.definitionFit: Inspired and animated are both synonyms for lively and full of fire.

clue.text: Incompetent husband appearing in not one short musical drama

indicators.note: appearing in means the husband's letter shows up inside the other pieces

parts.note: no means not one, as in no person

indicators.note: short means the musical drama loses its last letter

parts.note: an opera is a musical drama

explanation.surface: A useless husband turns up in a short opera, with no one else around.
explanation.definitionFit: A no-hoper is someone with no chance of success, an incompetent person; the noun works as a hopeless type.

clue.text: Deputy spiritual leader, revolutionary new Liberal in Central American country

indicators.note: in places the revolutionary, new and Liberal pieces inside the country's name

parts.note: Panama is a country in Central America
Che Guevara is the crossword's stock revolutionary

explanation.surface: A political story: a deputy religious figure, a revolutionary and a new Liberal politician turn up in Panama.
explanation.walkthrough: Che Guevara, the Argentine-born Cuban revolutionary, is the setters' favourite source of CHE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Panchen Lama is the second-ranking figure in Tibetan Buddhism, below the Dalai Lama.

clue.text: Others taking one exam

indicators.note: taking means the word for others holds the numeral inside it

parts.note: the rest means the others
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Some students sit a single exam, as others do.
explanation.definitionFit: A resit is a second sitting of an examination after failing it.

clue.text: Forceful detectives seizing loads, all lifted

indicators.note: in a down clue lifted means read upwards, and all says the whole assembly turns
seizing means the detectives hold the word for loads inside them

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, the British police detectives
many means loads, a large number

explanation.surface: Tough detectives grab loads of goods in a raid and haul it all away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all lifted' turns the whole assembly upwards, as this is a down clue; 'seizing' puts the loads inside the detectives.
explanation.definitionFit: Dynamic and forceful are synonyms for energetic and vigorous.

clue.text: Writer left trapped by insidious 15

indicators.note: trapped by means the writer and left pieces sit inside the word for insidious

parts.note: sly means insidious, cunning
the setter refers to themself as me, so writer gives ME

explanation.surface: A writer caught by something sneaky and foul.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the answer to clue 15, RANK, here in its sense of foul-smelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Rank means having a strong unpleasant odour, a synonym of the answer.

clue.text: Contemptible individual throttles smart poet

indicators.note: throttles means the contemptible individual grips the word for smart around the neck, inside it

parts.note: a swine is a contemptible person
smart as a verb means sting or burn

explanation.surface: A nasty person strangles a fashionable poet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smart' looks like an adjective describing the poet but is the verb, to sting.
explanation.definitionFit: Algernon Charles Swinburne was a Victorian English poet.

clue.text: What terminates life on world

indicators.note: terminates means the final letter of each of the words life, on and world

explanation.surface: A grim question of what brings life on earth to a close.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the definition and the wordplay: the last letters spell the word for what finishes things.
explanation.definitionFit: An end is what finishes or terminates something, including life on the planet.

clue.text: Dictionary of music, with following line, mostly way out

indicators.note: following means the musical word comes after the line and the shortened exit
mostly means all but the last letter of the word for way out

parts.note: an exit is a way out
con is the Italian musical direction meaning with, as in con brio

explanation.surface: A music dictionary entry for a line that seems mostly to lead off the page.
explanation.walkthrough: Italian 'con' (with) appears in score directions like con brio; 'following' puts it last, and 'mostly' trims the way out.
explanation.definitionFit: A lexicon is a dictionary, or the vocabulary of a language.

clue.text: Remain doubtful, sending out former relative share-price indicator

parts.note: a decision may hang, remain unresolved or in the balance

indicators.note: out means the letters of sending are put out of order

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse, a relative once

explanation.surface: Someone stays undecided about sending away an ex-spouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges SENDING into SENGIND.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hang Seng Index is the main stock-market index of Hong Kong, tracking share prices.

clue.text: Conclusion — did drugs when cycling

indicators.note: cycling means the letters go round, the back part brought to the front

parts.note: to shoot up is to inject drugs, so did drugs gives shot up

explanation.surface: A grim end to a story about someone taking drugs while out on a bike.
explanation.walkthrough: SHOT UP cycles to UPSHOT.
explanation.definitionFit: The upshot is the final outcome or result of something.

clue.text: Way of working alongside detective in book

parts.note: MO is modus operandi, a way of working
by means beside, alongside
dick is slang for a private detective

explanation.surface: A detective's method, described in a novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Moby-Dick is Herman Melville's novel about the white whale.

clue.text: Protection for viewers BBC chief covering animal sanctuary misses

indicators.note: covering means the BBC chief's letters sit around the sanctuary

parts.note: DG is the Director-General, head of the BBC
Noah's ark sheltered the animals from the flood
misses are young women, lasses

explanation.surface: A BBC boss covering an animal refuge story misses something meant to protect the audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'viewers' sounds like the BBC's TV audience but means eyes.
explanation.definitionFit: Dark glasses shield the eyes from bright sunlight, protecting the wearer's eyes.

clue.text: Mike perhaps turned cars around

indicators.note: around means the letters of the two words are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A man called Mike turned some cars round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mike' looks like a name; it is short for microphone.
explanation.definitionFit: A microphone is an example of a device converting one form of energy into another, sound to electrical signal.

clue.text: Division of international church in point over God

indicators.note: in means international and church go inside the word for point

parts.note: a dot is a point
O is the cricket abbreviation for an over
my, like God, is an exclamation of surprise

explanation.surface: A split in a worldwide church on a point of theology about God.
explanation.walkthrough: 'My!' works as an exclamation just as 'God!' does; 'over' is the cricket abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: A dichotomy is a division or contrast between two things.

clue.text: High position in hierarchical organisation

definitions.meaning: high here means smelling foul, as gamey meat does
a grade or standing in an army or company

explanation.surface: An elevated post in a structured organisation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High' reads as elevated, but here it means stinking, as of meat gone off.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: foul-smelling, and a grade or standing in a hierarchy.

clue.text: Fancy that — intermittently censored public records

indicators.note: intermittently censored means every other letter of the phrase is struck out, leaving the even ones

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise that official records have been censored now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: Acta are official proceedings or records of acts, a Latin plural.

clue.text: Caucasian male caught in clubs with broody female

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for the card suit clubs
he is a male pronoun
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a broody hen sits on eggs

explanation.surface: A man from the Caucasus is caught in a nightclub with a woman wanting children.
explanation.walkthrough: 'male caught' (HE C) sits in the clubs position after C.
explanation.definitionFit: A Chechen comes from Chechnya, in the Caucasus region.

clue.text: Pass 50 per cent of class drilled by fit workmates

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass

indicators.note: drilled by means the fit goes into the half lesson as a drill bores in
50 per cent of means the first half of the word for class

parts.note: a lesson is a class
an ague is a fit of shivering fever

explanation.surface: Fit workmates make half the class pass, drilled into them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'class' must be read as a single lesson, not a group of pupils; 'drilled by' puts the fit inside its first half.
explanation.definitionFit: Colleagues are people you work with, fellow workers.

clue.text: Sign lines in book collection

parts.note: Libra is a sign of the zodiac
RY is the abbreviation for railway, lines

explanation.surface: A sign posted with lines of text in a book collection.
explanation.definitionFit: A library is a collection of books.

clue.text: Pardon caught sexual deviant

indicators.note: deviant means straying from the norm, so the letters stray into a new order

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A sex offender is caught and then pardoned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deviant' rearranges C plus SEXUAL.
explanation.definitionFit: An excusal is a pardoning or release from blame or duty.

clue.text: On reflection, what about standing by grave sacrifice

indicators.note: on reflection means the word for what is seen in a mirror, back to front

parts.note: eh is a query meaning what
CA is circa, about
a tomb is a grave

explanation.surface: Thinking about what to do while standing by a grave at a serious sacrifice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grave' looks like an adjective for sacrifice but is the noun, tomb.
explanation.definitionFit: A hecatomb is a great public sacrifice, originally of a hundred oxen.

clue.text: Sister securing a civil engineer's degree

indicators.note: securing means the sister holds the letter a inside her

parts.note: a nun is a religious sister
CE is the abbreviation for civil engineer

explanation.surface: A nun obtains a civil engineering degree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'degree' looks like a qualification but means a fine shade of difference.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuance is a slight degree of difference in meaning or tone.

clue.text: Statesman placing staff administrators in Northeastern University

indicators.note: in means the administrators are placed within the university letters

parts.note: HR, human resources, manages a firm's staff

explanation.surface: A statesman places HR managers in a university in the northeast.
explanation.definitionFit: Jawaharlal Nehru was India's first prime minister, a statesman.

clue.text: Healers in this stopping work at six, to begin with

parts.note: to be in is to be at home
op is short for opus, a work

indicators.note: stopping means this word plugs a gap inside the other pieces like a stopper
to begin with means just the first letter of six

explanation.surface: Healers are in at work until stopping at six o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' means at home; 'stopping' plugs the word 'this' into the middle of the work-at-six letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Homeopathists practise homeopathy, a system of alternative healing.

clue.text: Grumble endlessly, as one who was permanently grounded

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the word for grumble is cut off

parts.note: to moan is to grumble

explanation.surface: Someone who complains endlessly, like a pilot permanently grounded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grounded' suggests a pilot or child; it means a bird unable to fly.
explanation.definitionFit: The moa was a large flightless New Zealand bird, now extinct.

clue.text: Public disgrace of infantry, land forces having run away

parts.note: INF is the abbreviation for infantry

indicators.note: having run away means the run letter leaves the word for land forces

parts.note: the army is a nation's land forces
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: The shame of foot soldiers and army fleeing.
explanation.definitionFit: Infamy is notoriety, public shame and dishonour.

clue.text: How Santa's helper might sign off reader emphatically

parts.note: yours is a standard sign-off to a letter
an elf helps Santa in his workshop

explanation.surface: How one of Santa's elves might end a letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yours, Elf' is the elf's sign-off.
explanation.definitionFit: The emphatic form of you, addressed to the reader, as in you and only you.
